messages:
Alex: Kicking off bootstrap for a new eu-central1 inference cluster (gpu-enabled). Goal: serve dedicated inference nodepools, private VPC peering, and standard base addons. Choosing between GKE autopilot vs kubeadm-on-vm. leaning GKE for faster ops but need to validate pod density + preemptible GPU cost tradeoffs.
Priya: +1 to GKE for speed, but we need to confirm regional GPU quota and image registry egress. Do we have quota for A100s in eu-central1?
Alex: Not yet — quota request submitted but expected delay. fallback plan: use T4/Tesla in same region until A100 quota approved. Cost note: T4 instance-hour ~1/6 A100 for perf/cost.
Jared: For node pool layout I'd suggest 2 pools: gpu-pool (tainted: gpu=true:NoSchedule, autoscaled) and cpu-pool (general purpose). Keep system pods on cpu-pool.
Marta: Add base addons checklist pls (CNI, ingress, certs, metrics, autoscaler, gpu plugin).
Alex: Here's the short runbook I used — keeping it minimal:

1) Preflight: VPC + subnet created, firewall rules for internal controlplane, IP ranges reserved. confirm with `gcloud compute networks subnets describe ...`
2) Provision cluster (GKE example):
```bash
gcloud container clusters create inference-eu1 
  --zone=europe-central1-a 
  --machine-type=n1-standard-16 
  --num-nodes=1 
  --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=1 --max-nodes=8 
  --enable-ip-alias 
  --enable-private-nodes --master-ipv4-cidr=10.0.0.0/28
  --enable-stackdriver-kubernetes
```
3) Create node pools: gpu pool with taints and node labels, install GPU drivers as DaemonSet if not provided.
4) Base addons: calico (CNI), cert-manager, nginx-ingress (or contour), metrics-server, cluster-autoscaler, prometheus node-exporter, kured.
5) GPU plugin: apply nvidia device-plugin DaemonSet and verify `kubectl get nodes -o=custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,GPU:.status.allocatable.nvidia\.com/gpu`
6) Networking: ensure peering to corp VPC, route export, NAT egress rules for model downloads, and private GCR access.
7) Validation: nodes Ready, kube-system pods Running, GPU visible via `nvidia-smi`, run 1-min perf job, smoke start serving container.
8) Handoff: add SRE oncall to project, upload runbook, create incident playbook entry.
```

Priya: Can you paste the gpu pool creation command? want to ensure labels/taints are consistent with autoscaler.
Alex: Sure — example:
```bash
gcloud container node-pools create gpu-pool 
  --cluster=inference-eu1 
  --zone=europe-central1-a 
  --machine-type=n1-standard-32 
  --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-t4,count=1 
  --num-nodes=0 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=0 --max-nodes=6 
  --node-taints=gpu=true:NoSchedule 
  --node-labels=role=gpu,env=prod
```
Jared: For autoscaler to work with GPU taints ensure pods have tolerations and you set `--scale-down-unneeded-time` appropriately. Also set resource limits on inference pods to avoid overcommit.
Marta: For base security: restrict node metadata access, enable shielded nodes (GKE option), and lock down RBAC for kube-system.
Alex: Quick validation commands I run post-creation: `kubectl get nodes -o wide`, `kubectl get pods -n kube-system`, `kubectl describe node <gpu-node> | grep -i nvidia`, `kubectl top nodes` (after metrics-server).
DevX: Small gotcha — GPU drivers may fail on custom COS images. if you see `nvidia-smi: command not found` check node image and install `nvidia-driver-installer` daemonset.
Priya: Networking check — ensure health checks from load balancer allowed on control plane subnet and that firewall rules are limited to corp IP ranges. Also confirm private cluster master authorized networks if we need API lockdown.
Alex: Cost control items: use preemptible/spot GPUs for batch workloads, reserved GPUs for latency-sensitive pods. also enable cost-annotations on namespaces for tracking.
Jared: Test plan before handoff: 1) Smoke deployment of small model container (cpu) 2) GPU inference container run through 1k sample calls to validate latency and KV cache warmup 3) Run `kubectl drain` on one node to test rolling behaviour.
Marta: Handoff checklist for SRE: link to runbook in repo, add k8s context creds to vault, add monitoring alerts (node not ready >5m, GPU allocatable drop), add oncall escalation policy.
Oncall Bot: Cluster inference-eu1 created (id=projects/xyz/zones/europe-central1-a/clusters/inference-eu1) — initial controlplane up, 1 node pool ready.
Alex: OK I'll run the validation steps now and post results. tagging @Jared @Priya for follow-up and handoff after green. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks — ping here when smoke tests done. :eyes:
Jared: If quota hangs up, fallback to t4 config I posted earlier. Keep costs in mind.
Marta: Nice, please also add brief note about regional model-cache egress cost; eu-central cross-region pulls get billed.
Alex: noted. I'll update runbook with driver fix links and add a short troubleshooting section for common GPU issues.
DevX: If you want I can add a quickstart doc for app teams to consume the new cluster once it's handed off.
Alex: Appreciate it — will send final handoff thread when done.
